title: Reference extraction output (B.4). One call per prepared transcript per model family.
description: Kept to keywords structured outputs accept: no numeric or length constraints, so importance is an enum. Item types are eval.reference.ITEM_TYPES (the ontology's fact_types plus task); owner_basis values are the ontology's.

items.description: Every item worth keeping from the call, one per distinct statement. Empty when there are none.

text.description: The item as a short, self-contained statement

owner.description: Tasks only: "Me" for the recording owner, a named person, or null. Null for every other type

mine.description: True only for a task the recording owner owns

due.description: Tasks only: the deadline exactly as stated, or null

quote.description: Words copied verbatim from one transcript line that support this item
